tickerText: [TENNIS] Cincinnati R32: Nakashima upsets Medvedev in twin tiebreaks; Sabalenka extends Masters streak to 45, Gauff & Swiatek advance • [SQUASH] Sana Bahadar claims first PSA title at Bendigo Open; Ivan Perez wins Valencia Memorial in 110-minute final • [BADMINTON] Delhi Worlds Day 3 — R32 underway as Lakshya Sen faces Tan; Ayush Shetty stunned defending champ Shi Yuqi on Day 1 • [PICKLEBALL] 2026-27 Carvana PPA season opens Aug 31 at Veolia Nationals in Cary — Waters, Johns headline $1.6M purse • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Europe Smash wraps: Wang Manyu & Felix Lebrun lift singles trophies; Lebrun brothers also win men's doubles in Malmö

newsItems.title: Nakashima Stuns Medvedev in Cincinnati
newsItems.excerpt: Brandon Nakashima rallied from twin tiebreaks to upset No. 4 Daniil Medvedev 6-7, 7-6, 6-1 in Cincinnati's Round of 32 — while Aryna Sabalenka hammered Wang Xinyu to extend her Masters 1000 win streak to 45.

newsItems.title: Delhi Worlds Enter Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: Day 3 of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi brings knockout action — Lakshya Sen, PV Sindhu and Satwik-Chirag lead India's charge after Ayush Shetty's shock win over defending champion Shi Yuqi.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026-27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off Aug 31 at Cary Tennis Park — the Veolia Pickleball National Championships debut the new World Pickleball Rankings with Anna Leigh Waters and Ben Johns headlining.

newsItems.title: Lebrun & Wang Manyu Rule Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: France's Felix Lebrun beat Tomokazu Harimoto 4-1 for his first WTT Grand Smash singles title, while China's Wang Manyu edged Wang Yidi 4-2 to claim her third — capping WTT Europe Smash Sweden 2026.
